stem: Anil, who lives in Jaipur, saves \((x + 250)\) rupees each week for 8 weeks. He then spends \((3x - 400)\) rupees on a gift. The amount, in rupees, he has left is equivalent to \(ax + b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. What is the value of \(b\)?
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = Poly(expand(8*(x + 250) - (3*x - 400)), x)
assert p.degree() == 1 and p.coeff_monomial(1) == 2400
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [2400]
